<function name="CapturePixels" parent="render" type="libraryfunc">
	<description><rendercontext hook="false" type="2D"></rendercontext>
	Dumps the current render target and allows the pixels to be accessed by <page>render.ReadPixel</page>. 

	Capturing outside a render hook will return an image filled with `0 0 0 255`.

	See also <page>render.Capture</page>.
</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
</function>
